Um, I’m sorry, but I actually don’t remember what email I used for the order. And I don’t have the order number either. Is there another way you can look it up? I really want to switch the bottle, but I don’t want to cancel anything. My name is Emma Kovacs and my zip code is 32190, if that helps.

Thanks, Emma—I've found your account: **emma_kovacs_9839**.

To check whether we can switch the **500ml** bottle to the **1L** version *without canceling*, I need the relevant **order** details (because the action depends on whether it’s **pending** or **delivered**).

Please tell me which order this is (any of the following is fine):
- the **order ID** (starts with **#W...**), or
- the **date** of purchase, or
- confirm if you have **one order** total or **multiple** (and roughly how many).

Once I know the order, I can look up its status and propose the exact item change.

I’m not sure about the order number, but I think I have two orders—one for the 500ml bottle and one for the 1L bottle. I placed both of them pretty recently, maybe within the last week. Sorry, I just don’t remember the exact dates. Is that enough to find the right order? I really want to make sure I get the bigger bottle in the same color as the other 1L one, if possible.
